## v1.14.0 — Active Server Intelligence + Web Search

Extends the AI pipeline introduced in v1.13 with automated server probing and live web search so ExploitAdvisor now produces fully macro-ready exploit instructions for the exact software and plugins running on the target server.

### Enhanced: ExploitAdvisor — Three-Stage Pipeline

The module now runs a full analysis pipeline automatically on join (configurable delay):

**Stage 1 — Active server probe (`ServerProbe`)**
- Sends `/version` and `/plugins` immediately after joining (with configurable delay)
- Parses the server's text responses to extract: server software (Paper/Spigot/Purpur/etc.), exact MC version, and a full plugin list with versions
- Falls back to passive brand-string and plugin-channel detection when commands return nothing
- State machine: IDLE → WAIT_VERSION → WAIT_PLUGINS → DONE (each stage times out after ~4 s)

**Stage 2 — Web search (`WebSearch`)**
- Queries DuckDuckGo HTML search (no API key required) for recent CVEs, dupe methods, and exploits targeting the detected software+version combination
- Runs additional targeted queries per plugin (top 3) to surface plugin-specific bugs
- Also searches dupedb.net for matching dupe entries
- Returns up to 12 text snippets, fed directly into the AI prompt

**Stage 3 — AI synthesis**
- AI receives: full server fingerprint (brand, software, MC version, plugin list with versions), any matching local exploit DB entries, and all web snippets
- Produces a numbered list (max 10) of specific, actionable exploits with **verbatim commands and macro strings** — ready to paste straight into a `/macro` or use in-game
- Prioritises duplication glitches, privilege escalation, economy exploits, inventory manipulation

### New Settings on ExploitAdvisor

| Setting | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `AutoOnJoin` | on | Fire the full pipeline automatically after joining |
| `WaitTicks` | 160 (8 s) | How long to wait after join before starting (gives ServerProbe time to complete) |
| `WebSearch` | on | Run DuckDuckGo web queries before asking the AI |
| `ProbeServer` | on | Send `/version` + `/plugins` to extract software details |

### New Internal Classes

- **`com.claudemc.server.ServerProbe`** — state-machine probe; drives command sending on the main thread via `tick()`, captures responses via `ClientReceiveMessageEvents.GAME`, resets on disconnect
- **`com.claudemc.ai.WebSearch`** — lightweight DuckDuckGo HTML scraper using Java's built-in `HttpClient` and regex; no extra dependencies
